map.圆锥销靠摩擦力定位、可重复装拆，直径按小端标称，承载较圆柱销低但防松好。: A taper pin locates by friction and can be assembled and disassembled repeatedly; its diameter is nominal at the small end, its load capacity is lower than a cylindrical pin but its locking is better.
map.销连接能传扭矩吗？: Can a pin joint transmit torque?
map.可传递较小扭矩（靠剪切），大扭矩需键/花键；销多用于定位与过载保护（剪断销）。: It can transmit small torques (by shear); large torques need a key/spline; pins are mostly used for locating and overload protection (shear pins).
map.为什么定位用过渡配合？: Why use a transition fit for locating?
map.定位销需不需松动又能拆装，常用过渡配合（如 H7/m6），过盈太紧难拆、间隙太松: A locating pin must not be loose yet remain removable, so a transition fit (such as H7/m6) is common; too much interference makes removal hard and too much clearance loses accuracy.
